note: Item codes are the .sav column names, unchanged by data/ecuador_2011_safety.do (Table 11 victimtype, local survey_cols I7401-I7406). The .sav variable labels tie each code to the form's q.7.4 sub-option by number and content, 6/6: I7401 = "I7401. Víctica de estafa" (sic), I7402 = "I7402. Víctima de robo", I7403 = "I7403. Víctima de intimidación / amenaza", I7404 = "I7404. Víctima de heridas / lesiones", I7405 = "I7405. Víctima de secuestro", I7406 = "I7406. Víctima de otro delito"; the form numbers the sub-options 1-6 in the same order. Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.9 (section VII. VÍCTIMA DE DELITOS, q.7.4), checked against the rendered page image, not the terse .sav labels. The stem 'De septiembre 2010 a agosto 2011, usted fue víctima de… (RM)' is shared by all six sub-options and goes in instructions; printed without an opening ¿, shipped as printed; the (RM) multiple-response marker and the interviewer line ANOTE LOS CÓDIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES (RM) are not shipped. item_text is each sub-option as printed, lower-case initials and the space before ? kept as on the form. I7406 is the catch-all 'Otro delito ?' with a write-in line labelled Especifique, shipped as 'Otro delito ? Especifique' (same convention as sibling ecuador_2011_safety_surroundings); the write-in content is not in the IRW table. Options: the form prints SI = 1 / NO = 2 / NO RESPONDE = 9 (upper case, as printed); .sav value labels Si=1 / No=2 / No responde=9. The do-file maps Si->1, No->0 and leaves No responde missing, then drops it, so IRW resp 1 = SI, 0 = NO (0 is a recode of form code 2, not a form code). Route 9 by server-side GROUP BY (no export): live item x resp counts equal .sav counts in 12/12 cells (resp 0/1: I7401 115518/2219; I7402 99098/18639; I7403 115320/2417; I7404 117197/539; I7405 117639/97; I7406 116752/360). Dropped No responde: I7404 1, I7405 1, I7406 625, so per-item n is 117737 except I7404/I7405 117736 and I7406 117112. Live: 705,795 rows, 117,737 ids (= all .sav informants), 0 duplicate id-item. Source observation (not a transform defect): respondents answering No to q.7.2 (n=95,549) are coded No on 7.4 in the .sav, except 14 Si cells (I7402 10, I7403 3, I7406 1) that contradict their own q.7.2 answer; IRW reproduces the .sav as published. English _translated columns are machine translation by this project.
